_about: Kecha Wacha with his ears folded over his face. Four LOCAL bone rotations, lifted from em065_00_2.glb Motion[116] at 0.40s -- the one frame in all 191 clips where the ear mesh covers the whole eye. The pose needs nothing else: the eye is 100% weighted to head bone 3, the ear parts are 99.99% on these four bones, and their chain hangs off bone 3, so the drape is a pure function of these rotations and is unaffected by whatever the head and body are doing. NOT a visibility group -- uEm065_00 has eight setVisibleGroup sites and none of them move the ears.
